chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Yahya al-Khazaz from Ammar ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'There are servants of Allah about whom Allah does not care at all; they have wombs like women.' It was asked, 'O Commander of the Faithful, do they not get pregnant?' He replied, 'Their wombs are inverted (or like balloons).'

key_terms.أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.مَنْکُوسَهٌ: Inverted / turned upside down / lacking function

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'mankusah' mean regarding the wombs of men in this hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (a) narrating from Imam Ali (a) regarding a specific group of men afflicted with a unique anatomical condition, often interpreted by Shia scholars as a sign of the Qarun-like arrogance or a distinct category of sinners. The term 'mankusah' (inverted) describes their wombs as turned upside down, indicating a state of sterility or functional inversion that mirrors their spiritual disconnection from divine mercy, despite possessing the physical attribute of women.
